gizmo.title: Saf ururin
gizmo.description: Walax saf u eg oo loogu talagalay liiska ururinta, leh qoraal, xiriiriye, astaan, summado, iyo sawir ikhtiyaari ah.

configure.title: Alt
configure.description: Qoraal beddel ah oo sharaxaya sawirka.

advanced.title: Saamaynta dhereg midabka
advanced.description: Beddel dhereg midabka sawirka marka isticmaaluhu diiradda saaro.

advanced.title: Summado
advanced.description: Liis summado ah oo hakad lagu kala saaray.

advanced.title: Midab
advanced.description: Midabka loo isticmaalo astaanta iyo summadaha.
